stem.en: Which help suits each request best?

text.en: Is my train from Howrah late today?
How much rain fell in Mumbai this morning?
The exact cost of 3,764 bricks at ₹8.75 each
Make this sentence simpler to read
Write a short story about a lost kite

explanation.en: A pile ends on some date, so today's news has to arrive as text from a search. A calculator is surer for exact arithmetic, and it works as an outside checker; the model can also work a sum out on paper, as a later lesson shows. Rewriting and storytelling need no outside facts, so the model can do them alone.

hints.en: Ask what the answer depends on: today's events, exact arithmetic, or neither.
